memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Asthma, intermittent; Hypertension, stage 1.
Patient reports occasional wheeze on exertion, no nighttime symptoms. BP 148/92 mmHg, pulse 78, respiratory rate 18, SpO2 96% on room air. Lung examination reveals scattered wheezes bilaterally, no crackles. Cardiac exam normal. Spirometry: FEV1 2.85 L (92% predicted), FVC 3.60 L (95% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.79. Change in FEV1 since prior: not applicable. Asthma Control Test score 22 (well controlled). Technique checked: correct for salbutamol metered-dose inhaler. Smoking status: never.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Salbutamol 100 mcg metered-dose inhaler, 2 puffs PRN wheeze.
Fluticasone/salmeterol 250/50 mcg dry powder inhaler, 1 inhalation BD.
Amlodipine 5 mg OD.
Telmisartan 40 mg OD.
Losartan 50 mg OD.
Hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg OD.

ECG: sinus rhythm, rate 72, no ST-T changes, left ventricular voltage within normal limits.

memories.text: I feel much better since using the spacer with my salbutamol inhaler. No nighttime cough and I can walk upstairs without getting short of breath.
